name: winteam-pr-video
description: Records a before/after video of a WinTeam Mobile fix for its pull request. Reads the Jira ticket (through the Atlassian connector when present) and the diff against the PR's base branch, writes a short Python scenario that reproduces the bug, and shows it for approval. Then it builds the base version in a reusable git worktree and the branch version, clean-installs each on the Android emulator or iOS simulator, records the scenario on both, and joins the two into one labelled side-by-side video. After the video it asks before pushing and opening the PR. Reuses winteam-device-testing's pinned Appium install, WebDriver client, login routine, test account and device list, so a teammate who set that plugin up has little left to do. Password safety: the login is the dependency's keyboard-only routine; Appium runs on its own port with typed text redacted from its log and stops after each run; Android logcat is cleared after sign-in; inspect never saves the sign-in page; a recording is deleted when the sign-in form was filled wrong. Runs expire after 7 days. macOS only.

worktree_files.title: Untracked files to copy into the base worktree
worktree_files.description: Comma-separated paths, relative to the WinTeam-Mobile root, of local files a clean checkout needs to build (for example WinTeam.Mobile.iOS/Directory.Build.props). Leave empty if none.

android_avd.title: Android emulator (AVD) to record on
android_avd.description: Leave empty to use the phone AVD from winteam-device-testing's devices.json.

ios_simulator.title: iOS simulator to record on
ios_simulator.description: Simulator name, for example 'iPhone 17 Pro'. Leave empty to use the phone simulator from winteam-device-testing's devices.json. The runtime always comes from devices.json.
